item.title: Uber Rebuilds Asia Presence Starting Small in Macau
item.description: With the Macau entry, Uber is making its way back into Asia. But it is moving slowly. And this time, it is sticking to the rules.

item.title: Investment Firm L+R Targets Hotels as Institutional Funds Retreat
item.description: L+R’s reorganization underscores a broader trend in how specialist investors aim to get an edge over generalist real estate funds in hotel investing. Its plan to spend over $250 million on properties in its new Iconic hotel collection is one example.

item.title: Qantas to Exit Jetstar Japan as Airline Shifts to Full Japanese Control
item.description: This is the latest example of Qantas pulling back from its overseas minority investments to focus on its core Australian brands.

item.title: For Corporate Travel, the 2026 World Cup Is Becoming a Multi-City Business Platform
item.description: For a tournament billed as a once-in-a-lifetime business travel moment, friction over U.S. border rules poses a real threat to revenue and the experience.

item.title: How Ibis Is Betting on Social-First Storytelling With a Creator-Led Miniseries
item.description: Rather than chasing attention with traditional ads, Ibis is doubling down on entertainment. “The Go Getters” shows how social-first, episodic storytelling can help hospitality brands build relevance and brand affinity with younger travelers.

item.title: Kayak CEO Steve Hafner Exits Post After 22 Years
item.description: Don't expect Hafner to stick around for an extended period in the new executive chair role.

item.title: Disney’s Pick for New CEO Shows Rising Power of Parks and Experiences
item.description: Disney is increasingly a travel company, with parks and experiences accounting for the majority of profits.

item.title: Here’s What Travel Companies Are Doing for Super Bowl Ads
item.description: Super Bowl ads cost more than $8 million for a 30-second spot, and it appears some travel brands are taking a pass this year.

item.title: Steve Hafner’s 22-Year Run at Kayak: Skift Timeline
item.description: Kayak's Steve Hafner has seen everything in online travel, from the founding of airline-owned Orbitz to the AI era.

item.title: Chalet Doubles Down on Premium Hospitality With Athiva Expansion
item.description: Chalet’s Athiva push shows how Indian hotel operators are using rebranding and pricing power and not just occupancy growth, to capture the country’s premium travel boom.
